items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Yeah, I had the privilege of playing with George Lewis. He hired me with his little combo, see.

ctx.x: Who was he with in those times?

Well I don't know. George would look like he was freelancing, you know. He'd play with, you know, just so many of them, but he was always so popular, so busy, you know. Yeah. He had another tall brownskin fellow, I don't know his name. He played fine clarinet for brass band work. But George Lewis, see I made a couple of jobs with him years ago, see, playing at a hall, a ballroom, see, back on the main street between Claiborne and, what is that? San Jacinto. San Jacinto. Yeah, I had the privilege of playing with…
